name: Sasaki Kazusa
source:
Hobbies: Looking up animal videos, cosplaying by herself
Likes: All japanese food (fish>meat), cute clothes
Plane: Ki-44 Shoki

A second year who ends up sharing a room with Junichi due to a mix-up when they first come to the dorm.
A classic tsundere who can't hide the fact that she can be a bit of ditz from time to time.
She can sometimes be seen sneaking off to talk with someone on the phone... but with who?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/906300/Under_One_Wing/]Steam[/url]]
